title: The Lunchtime Money Q&A
content: For years, Rosa and I ran a lunchtime money Q&A at the firm. Anybody could walk in with a sandwich and a question. [laughter] I was the numbers nerd, obviously. Rosa's a financial planner - the one who actually knows how this stuff lands in real life. College savings, taxes, how much you can spend in retirement - we got every question. The fun part was our dynamic. I'd go deep into the research, and Rosa would say 'Nate, in English please.' [laughter] It kept me honest.
follow_up: One time a guy from the mailroom stood up and asked the question every executive in the room was too proud to ask: 'Am I going to be okay?' Rosa answered him in three sentences. I was taking notes. [laughter] That's when I learned the best answer is usually the simplest one.
